title: Trumpet with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Bell of the trumpet (right side) -->
  <ellipse cx="78" cy="50" rx="18" ry="22" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <ellipse cx="78" cy="50" rx="13" ry="17" fill="#FFB300"/>
  <ellipse cx="78" cy="50" rx="7" ry="10" fill="#FF8F00"/>

  <!-- Main tube body -->
  <rect x="30" y="43" width="42" height="14" rx="7" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <!-- Highlight on tube -->
  <rect x="34" y="46" width="34" height="4" rx="2" fill="#FFE44D"/>

  <!-- Valves (pistons on top) -->
  <rect x="38" y="30" width="8" height="16" rx="3" fill="#FFB300"/>
  <rect x="40" y="32" width="4" height="6" rx="2" fill="#FFE44D"/>
  <rect x="50" y="27" width="8" height="19" rx="3" fill="#FFB300"/>
  <rect x="52" y="29" width="4" height="6" rx="2" fill="#FFE44D"/>
  <rect x="62" y="30" width="8" height="16" rx="3" fill="#FFB300"/>
  <rect x="64" y="32" width="4" height="6" rx="2" fill="#FFE44D"/>

  <!-- Valve caps -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="29" r="4" fill="#FF8F00"/>
  <circle cx="54" cy="26" r="4" fill="#FF8F00"/>
  <circle cx="66" cy="29" r="4" fill="#FF8F00"/>

  <!-- Mouthpiece (left side) -->
  <rect x="20" y="46" width="12" height="8" rx="4" fill="#FFB300"/>
  <rect x="14" y="47" width="8" height="6" rx="3" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <ellipse cx="14" cy="50" rx="3" ry="4" fill="#FFE44D"/>

  <!-- Little rim at the bell opening -->
  <ellipse cx="94" cy="50" rx="4" ry="20" fill="#FFE44D" opacity="0.9"/>

  <!-- Smiling face on the tube body -->
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx="44" cy="47" r="3" fill="#5A3A00"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="47" r="3" fill="#5A3A00"/>
  <!-- Eye sparkles -->
  <circle cx="45" cy="46" r="1" fill="#FFF8E1"/>
  <circle cx="59" cy="46" r="1" fill="#FFF8E1"/>

  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d="M44 53 Q51 59 58 53" stroke="#5A3A00" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>

  <!-- Rosy cheeks -->
  <circle cx="38" cy="52" r="3" fill="#FF7A59" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="64" cy="52" r="3" fill="#FF7A59" opacity="0.7"/>
</svg>
